title: Carbon Pool Demand Analytics
tagline: Identify the best candidates for new carbon pools by comparing off-chain demand with available on-chain supply
description: The current carbon pools on-chain (BCT, NCT, MCO2, UBO, NBO) do not offer sufficient differentiation to allow proper pricing of carbon tonnage being consumed off-chain. We aim to identify clusters of demand for legitimate offsetting in the off-chain market, and scope out pool candidates that have sufficient volume of credits to be liquid, yet are differentiated enough from the current pools to justify separate liquidity.
how_its_made: We are working with the standard Python data science stack (pandas, Plotly). Our project combines off-chain data from the Verra registry, as well as on-chain data from a Bridged Carbon Subgraph and a manually labeled dataset. We are building on top of the Toucan Protocol and within the broader on-chain carbon markets spurred by KlimaDAO.
